sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 Documentation: Text Search Types
sources.observed_operation: Read official documentation via web open/search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: tsvector stores normalized lexemes; to_tsvector applies language normalization; positional data is available for proximity ranking; this is lexical matching, not semantic equivalence.
sources.applicability: A self-managed/local lexical baseline when a database is acceptable; no claim that this alone meets relevance, citation, version, or permission needs.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 Documentation: GIN Indexes
sources.locator: §65.4, built-in operator classes, GIN Fast Update Technique
sources.observed_operation: Read official documentation via web open/search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: GIN supports tsvector @@ tsquery. Fast update may queue pending entries; searches scan those entries and can slow; cleanup can cause slower spikes. Turning fastupdate off favors response consistency at the expense of update speed.
sources.applicability: Evidence for indexing freshness/latency trade-offs, not an authorization guarantee or product choice.

sources.title: Elastic Documentation: Hybrid Search
sources.version_or_commit: Current Elastic documentation as served 2026-10-12; deployment version not pinned
sources.locator: Hybrid search overview and RRF recommendation
sources.observed_operation: Read vendor product documentation via web search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Runs full-text and vector search in one request; Elastic recommends RRF for balanced fusion; vendor recommendation is not independent evidence of relevance for this corpus.
sources.applicability: Illustrates a maintained hybrid approach. Validate exact features, license, deployment and permission integration against a selected release.

sources.title: OpenSearch Documentation: Hybrid Search
sources.version_or_commit: Current /latest documentation; feature introduced in OpenSearch 2.11; exact deployment version not pinned
sources.observed_operation: Read official docs via web search/open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Hybrid requires a search pipeline for score processing; top-level pre-filter is before scoring; post_filter applies after scoring and may be intended for facets. Do not use post-filtering to enforce authorization.
sources.applicability: Alternative open-source engine pattern; verify pipeline presence, filter semantics, plugin/model deployment, release behavior, and tested query shape.

sources.title: OpenSearch Documentation: Document-Level Security
sources.version_or_commit: Current /latest documentation, accessed 2026-10-12; feature/version details vary by plugin release
sources.locator: user field mapping examples; parameter substitution; TLQ modes; DLS and multiple roles
sources.observed_operation: Read official security documentation via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DLS filters read/search/get; does not restrict writes. Default TLQ mode is adaptive. Text analyzer may split identifiers such as User-1; use keyword or custom analyzer for exact IDs. Multiple role DLS queries combine with OR; dfm_empty_overrides_all changes override behavior.
sources.applicability: Illustrates engine-enforced result filtering and configuration hazards; not evidence of immediate source-ACL revocation or safe disclosure of every metadata channel.

sources.title: OpenSearch neural-search issue #1490 and pull request #1873
sources.version_or_commit: Issue opened 2025-07-31; PR merged 2026-06-18; fix commit shown as fc1be2e
sources.locator: Issue reproduction for multi-shard dfs_query_then_fetch; PR validation and error message
sources.observed_operation: Read upstream issue and merged PR directly.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The bug skipped hybrid score normalization for multi-shard DFS search. The merged change adds request/query-phase validation and rejects dfs_query_then_fetch; it does not support the combination.
sources.applicability: Relevant failure/fix history; pin and validate the selected release, and surface unsupported configurations instead of assuming all query modes fuse correctly.

sources.title: Typesense 28.0 API Keys
sources.locator: Generate Scoped Search Key, multi-tenant examples
sources.observed_operation: Read versioned official product documentation via web search/open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Scoped search keys embed filter_by/exclude_fields/limit_hits; docs advise generating per-user keys server-side and note parent-key deletion invalidates derived scoped keys. Key permissions still depend on correct indexed ACL metadata and key custody.
sources.applicability: Unfamiliar maintained alternative for restricted search parameters; does not provide edition identity, current source permission lookup, or revocation of copied output.

sources.title: Azure AI Search query-time ACL and RBAC enforcement
sources.locator: Security filter construction, result filtering, failure/limitations, preview behavior change around lines 163-171
sources.observed_operation: Read official Microsoft Learn page via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: When permission filtering is enabled, service appends permission filters; without a user token, protected ACL results are omitted; ACL evaluation failures return 5xx rather than a partial set. Earlier 2025 preview behavior could return all docs under service credentials, changed starting Nov 2025. Group sources and refresh behavior are ingestion-dependent.
sources.applicability: Shows fail-closed query-time enforcement and relevant release-history caution. Managed service use would require approved data residency/private-content boundary and API-version review.

sources.title: Azure AI Search push ACL and RBAC API
sources.version_or_commit: Push API ACL functionality is preview; page last updated 2026-09-17
sources.locator: Preview warning; limitations and ACL access resolution rules
sources.observed_operation: Read official Microsoft Learn page via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Preview is explicitly not recommended for production or covered by SLA. Indexed permission reflects last written ACL; source permission changes remain stale until document re-ingestion/update. Limits include 1,000 user/group values per ACL field and five unique RBAC scope values per index.
sources.applicability: Concrete synchronization trade-off, but the preview status and private-data boundary prevent treating it as an approved solution.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.locator: §4.1 Time State; §4.2.4 Text Quote Selector; §4.2.5 Text Position Selector
sources.observed_operation: Read W3C Recommendation via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Quote selectors require exact text; prefix/suffix are recommended; duplicate exact/prefix/suffix matches may designate all matches; normalized Unicode code points/logical order apply. Position selectors do not copy quote text but are brittle under edits; a State is recommended.
sources.applicability: Interoperable locator vocabulary; add application-specific edition IDs and authorization; quote text in a citation can itself disclose restricted content.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph driveItemVersion resource and Get operation
sources.locator: Version id, content stream/download version method, least-privilege permissions, downloadUrl notes
sources.observed_operation: Read Microsoft Graph resource and GET API docs via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A version has an ID and can be individually retrieved with authorized Graph access. The instance download URL needs no auth, is short-lived (up to 1 hour), cannot be cached, and file permission removal might not immediately invalidate it. OneDrive may not retain full prior-version metadata.
sources.applicability: Concrete edition-addressed retrieval example and strong warning against using its download URL as a durable, revocable citation.

sources.title: Elastic document-level and field-level security
sources.version_or_commit: Current Elastic docs as served 2026-10-12; deployment version/license not selected
sources.locator: Multiple roles with DLS/FLS; global-index statistics caveat; request cache limitations
sources.observed_operation: Read official Elastic security documentation via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: DLS is OR across role queries; a role without DLS may widen access to all docs. Restricted docs can still affect global index statistics/aggregates and reveal terms/counts. Request cache is disabled only under documented conditions (e.g., templated stored-script DLS or mixed local/remote indices), not universally.
sources.applicability: Security review checklist for this vendor approach; design must also suppress titles/snippets and avoid metadata side channels.

sources.title: Elastic Aliases
sources.version_or_commit: Current Elastic docs as served 2026-10-12; release not pinned
sources.locator: Multiple alias actions; atomic index swap
sources.observed_operation: Read official Elastic documentation via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Multiple alias actions execute atomically; sample removes old and adds new, with no downtime and no moment pointing at both. It describes routing, not retention/ACL freshness/authorization of old indexes.
sources.applicability: Bulk rebuild pattern candidate, to be combined with source revision and permission-generation checks.

sources.title: Git rev-parse documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Current Git documentation as served 2026-10-12; local Git version not selected
sources.observed_operation: Read official Git documentation via web search.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: rev:path addresses the blob/tree at a path within the selected commit. It is usable only if the source is in a retained Git repository; a line number or moving ref is not the immutable edition ID.
sources.applicability: Version-control locator alternative, not generalizable to platform-managed docs or authorization.

sources.title: Microsoft Graph List driveItem versions
sources.version_or_commit: Microsoft Graph v1.0; page last updated 2025-10-22
sources.observed_operation: Read the official Microsoft Graph page via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: OneDrive and SharePoint history retention is configurable; versions can be created per edit/save, manually, or never. Previous versions may be retained for finite periods by admin settings that can vary by user or location. OneDrive does not preserve complete metadata for previous versions.
sources.applicability: Shows an archive/version ID is not a guarantee of indefinite retention. Exact source platform policies must be checked by owners.

sources.title: Microsoft SharePoint version history limits FAQ
sources.locator: FAQ on expired/trimmed versions and legal holds or retention policies
sources.observed_operation: Read official Microsoft Learn page via web open.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Expired/trimmed versions can be permanently deleted and unavailable for recycle-bin restoration; background purge can take days. Retention/legal hold controls whether deletion is deferred and later extended or executed. Version count trimming is gradual on file updates.
sources.applicability: Concrete SharePoint behavior demonstrating why historical citation retention and withdrawal must be explicit owner/policy decisions; not a universal archive guarantee.
